import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
times = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Y: 30 sec = 10 won (0-29: 10, 30-59: 20, ...)
# M: 60 sec = 15 won (0-59: 15, 60-119: 30, ...)

y_cost = sum((t // 30 + 1) * 10 for t in times)
m_cost = sum((t // 60 + 1) * 15 for t in times)

if y_cost < m_cost:
    print(f"Y {y_cost}")
elif m_cost < y_cost:
    print(f"M {m_cost}")
else:
    print(f"Y M {y_cost}")
